content: The ChatGPT Plus/Codex usage quota endpoint is GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/usage (undocumented internal backend API powering the Codex analytics page at chatgpt.com/codex/cloud/settings/analytics). Response contains rate_limit.primary_window and rate_limit.secondary_window, each {used_percent:int, reset_at:unix-ts}, plus plan_type, rate_limit.limit_reached, credits.balance. Auth: Bearer access token from ~/.codex/auth.json (Codex CLI OAuth login) with optional ChatGPT-Account-ID header; alternative is ChatGPT session cookies. Verified in three independent sources (withLinda/CodexPlusBar Swift app, liamlai88/ai-usage-bar Python, and this repo's feature/openai-quota branch).
